name: Sharpness
long_desc: Increases melee damage dealt to all mobs and players. The bread-and-butter offensive enchantment for swords and axes.

name: Smite
long_desc: Increases melee damage dealt exclusively to undead mobs: zombies, skeletons, phantoms, the Wither, wither skeletons, zoglins, drowned, husks, strays, skeleton horses, and zombie horses.

name: Bane of Arthropods
long_desc: Increases melee damage and inflicts Slowness IV on arthropod mobs: spiders, cave spiders, bees, silverfish, and endermites.

advanced.formula: 2.5 * L damage + Slowness IV for random(1.0, 1.5) seconds
2.5 * L damage + Slowness IV for random(1.5, 2.0) seconds
2.5 * L damage + Slowness IV for random(2.0, 2.5) seconds
2.5 * L damage + Slowness IV for random(2.5, 3.0) seconds
2.5 * L damage + Slowness IV for random(3.0, 3.5) seconds

name: Knockback
long_desc: Increases the horizontal knockback applied to mobs and players struck by a melee attack.

advanced.formula: knockback_strength = L (each unit ≈ 3 extra blocks of horizontal push)

name: Fire Aspect
short_desc: Melee hits set targets on fire.
long_desc: Sets the target on fire on melee hit. Fire deals 1 damage every 2 seconds. Also cooks food drops from mobs (pork, beef, chicken, etc.) automatically.

name: Looting
long_desc: Increases the maximum item drop count from mobs and raises the chance of rare drops. The go-to enchantment for farming.
special_notes: Increases max drop count by 1 per level

name: Sweeping Edge
long_desc: Increases the damage dealt by the sword's sweep attack  the horizontal arc that hits multiple nearby mobs.

levels.short: Sweep Attack Damage: 50% of base damage
Sweep Attack Damage: 66.7% of base damage
Sweep Attack Damage: 75% of base damage

name: Protection
long_desc: Reduces damage taken from all sources except void damage and /kill. Contributes EPF (Enchantment Protection Factor) which stacks across all armor pieces, capped globally at 25 EPF (80% reduction).

levels.short: +4 EPF (≈4% general damage reduction per piece)

special_notes: EPF capped at 25 across all armor pieces combined

name: Fire Protection
long_desc: Reduces fire damage and shortens the duration of burn effects. Uses fire-specific EPF which is separate from general Protection.

name: Blast Protection
long_desc: Reduces explosion damage and knockback from all explosion sources: creepers, TNT, beds used in the Nether, respawn anchors used in the Overworld, and more.

name: Projectile Protection
long_desc: Reduces damage taken from all projectile sources: arrows, fireballs, tridents, shulker bullets, llama spit, and more.

name: Feather Falling
long_desc: Reduces fall damage taken. Does NOT reduce damage from ender pearl teleportation.

levels.short: +24 Fall EPF (≈ 48% reduction from this piece alone)
+36 Fall EPF (exceeds cap alone combined bonuses are at max)

name: Respiration
long_desc: Extends underwater breathing time, reduces drowning damage frequency, and improves underwater visibility.

name: Aqua Affinity
long_desc: Removes the 5× mining speed penalty applied when the player's head is submerged underwater.

name: Thorns
long_desc: Grants a percentage chance to deal reflected damage to attackers when the player is struck. Stacks across multiple armor pieces but degrades durability faster on each proc.

levels.short: 15% chance to reflect 1–4 damage per piece
30% chance to reflect 1–4 damage per piece
45% chance to reflect 1–4 damage per piece

special_notes: Each piece rolls independently for proc chance

name: Depth Strider
long_desc: Increases movement speed underwater. Level III restores the player to full walking speed while submerged.

levels.short: Underwater speed: ≈33% of land speed restored
Underwater speed: ≈67% of land speed restored

name: Frost Walker
long_desc: Converts water blocks beneath the player's feet into frosted ice as they walk. Also grants complete immunity to magma block damage.

levels.short: Freezes water in a 2-block radius; magma immunity
Freezes water in a 3-block radius; magma immunity

special_notes: Ice melts if a heat source is nearby

name: Soul Speed
long_desc: Increases movement speed on soul sand and soul soil blocks. Slowly consumes boot durability while active.

levels.short: Speed ×1.3 on soul sand/soil; boots slowly degrade

name: Swift Sneak
long_desc: Increases movement speed while the player is sneaking.

advanced.formula: sneak_speed_bonus = 0.15 * L (fraction of normal walk speed added to sneak)

special_notes: Treasure enchantment: only found in Ancient City chests

name: Efficiency
long_desc: Increases mining speed on blocks the tool is effective against. Scales exponentially  the jump from level IV to V is huge.

name: Silk Touch
long_desc: Causes mined blocks to drop themselves in their original form instead of their normal drops. Essential for obtaining glass, ice, grass blocks, ores, and more.

name: Fortune
long_desc: Increases item drop quantity when mining eligible blocks including ores, crops, and gravel. Does not work on all block types.

levels.short: Avg ~1.33× ore drops (e.g. 1–2 diamonds per ore)

advanced.formula: avg_multiplier varies by block; gravel flint chance = 14/15

levels.short: Avg ~1.75× ore drops (e.g. 1–3 diamonds per ore)

advanced.formula: avg_multiplier varies by block; gravel flint chance = 24/25

levels.short: Avg ~2.2× ore drops (e.g. 1–4 diamonds per ore)

advanced.formula: avg_multiplier varies by block; gravel flint chance = 100%

name: Unbreaking
long_desc: Grants a chance to skip durability loss each use. Effectively multiplies the item's usable lifespan.

name: Mending
long_desc: Repairs the item using XP orbs collected by the player. Each XP point consumed restores 2 durability. XP is diverted to repair instead of being added to the experience bar.

levels.short: Repairs 2 durability per XP point consumed

special_notes: XP orbs collected repair the item instead of leveling the player

name: Power
long_desc: Increases arrow damage dealt by bows.

name: Punch
long_desc: Increases the knockback applied to entities hit by bow arrows.

name: Flame
long_desc: All arrows fired by this bow are ignited, setting targets ablaze on impact for additional fire damage over time.

name: Infinity
long_desc: Firing the bow does not consume regular arrows from the inventory. Requires at least one regular arrow somewhere in inventory to activate. Does not work with tipped or spectral arrows.

levels.short: Regular arrows not consumed on fire

advanced.formula: binary toggle  regular arrows not consumed if one exists in inventory

special_notes: Requires at least one arrow in inventory to shoot

name: Luck of the Sea
long_desc: Increases the probability of catching treasure loot while fishing and decreases the probability of catching junk.

name: Lure
long_desc: Decreases the wait time before a fish bites the hook while fishing.

name: Loyalty
long_desc: A thrown trident automatically returns to the player after hitting its target or landing. Return speed increases with level.

name: Channeling
long_desc: During a thunderstorm, a thrown trident that directly strikes a mob or player summons a lightning bolt on the target.

levels.short: Summons lightning on mob hit during thunderstorms

advanced.formula: binary toggle  requires active thunderstorm + clear sky access to target

name: Riptide
short_desc: Tridents launch you through water or rain.
long_desc: Launching a trident while in water or rain propels the player forward instead of throwing the trident. Damage is dealt to any mob the player collides with during the launch.

levels.short: Launches player forward in water or rain

advanced.formula: launch_velocity scales with L; requires water contact or active rain

special_notes: Mutually exclusive with Loyalty and Channeling

name: Impaling
long_desc: Increases trident damage against aquatic mobs. In Java Edition, also affects any mob or player currently in contact with water (including during rain).

levels.short: +2.5 damage vs aquatic/wet mobs (Java: any mob in water/rain)

name: Multishot
long_desc: Fires 3 arrows simultaneously from a crossbow in a spread arc, but only consumes 1 arrow from inventory.

name: Piercing
long_desc: Arrows fired from a crossbow pass through entities, hitting multiple targets in a straight line.

name: Quick Charge
long_desc: Reduces crossbow loading time by 0.25 seconds per level.

name: Curse of Binding
long_desc: Once equipped in an armor slot, the cursed item cannot be removed by the player. Only removed on death or when the item breaks from zero durability.

levels.short: ⚠ CURSE: Cannot remove from armor slot until death or item breaks

advanced.formula: binary penalty  unequip blocked while player is alive in Survival/Adventure

name: Curse of Vanishing
long_desc: The item is permanently destroyed when the player dies instead of dropping on the ground as normal.

levels.short: ⚠ CURSE: Item permanently deleted on death

advanced.formula: binary penalty  item is destroyed on player death

name: Wind Burst
long_desc: When the mace's smash attack connects, a wind burst launches the wielder upward, enabling repeated aerial smash attacks.

name: Density
short_desc: Smash attacks deal more fall damage.
long_desc: Increases the bonus damage the mace deals per block fallen before a smash attack connects. Stacks with the mace's base fall damage bonus.

levels.short: +0.5 bonus damage per block fallen before smash

name: Breach
long_desc: Reduces the target's effective armor value when struck by a mace smash attack.

levels.short: Target armor effectiveness -15% on smash hit

name: Lunge
long_desc: Propels the player horizontally in the direction they are facing when performing a spear jab attack. Only activates on jab attacks (not charge attacks). Consumes hunger and 1 durability per use. Requires at least 6 hunger points to activate.

levels.short: Jab launches you at 9.16 blocks/s; costs 1 hunger point
Jab launches you at 18.32 blocks/s; costs 2 hunger points
Jab launches you at 27.48 blocks/s; costs 3 hunger points
